visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a wide shot of a large beige camping tent already partially pitched next to a silver Volkswagen camper van in a gravel campsite. A man in a blue t-shirt and dark pants begins to unfold a massive section of light-colored fabric on the ground. (2) Close-up shots show the man's hands as he slides long black fiberglass poles into the stitched sleeves of the tent body. He wears a braided watch strap and works with focused movements. (3) The man attaches black plastic clips to the poles to secure the tent's frame. The camera cuts frequently to show different angles of this mechanical process. (4) Transitioning to the roof of the silver van, the man uses nylon straps and hooks to anchor the top of the tent to the vehicle's gutter rail and roof rack. (5) In a series of low-angle close-ups, an orange-handled hammer is used to drive metal stakes into the rocky gravel, securing the base of the tent structure. (6) The man demonstrates the functionality of the tent by unzipping front panels and rolling them up, revealing the spacious interior. (7) A woman in a black top and jeans joins the man. Together, they begin unloading camping furniture, including folding chairs, a table, and storage boxes from the rear of the van into the tent area. (8) The video concludes with a top-down aerial drone shot, showing the complete setup: the van, the fully expanded tent, and the organized living space below, surrounded by green and autumn-colored trees.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator performing the setup, 1 female assistant appearing later to help with furniture.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Adult male wearing glasses, a dark blue short-sleeved t-shirt, dark cargo pants, tan hiking boots, and a paracord-style watch band.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A gravel-surfaced outdoor camping area nestled in a wooded valley. Lush green trees and a few trees with vibrant red autumn leaves provide a scenic backdrop. A small thatched-roof gazebo or hut is visible in the distance.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the heavy, expansive rustling of tent fabric being unfolded on a gravel surface. This is accompanied by the rhythmic crunch of hiking boots on loose stone. (2) A series of sharp, metallic 'clicks' occur as fiberglass poles are snapped into segments. High-frequency friction sounds are heard as poles slide through the nylon sleeves of the tent. (3) Distinctive plastic 'snaps' mark the moment clips are attached to the frame. (4) The audio features rhythmic, percussive thuds as a metal hammer impacts tent stakes against the rocky ground. (5) Fast-moving zipping sounds occur as the man opens various panels. (6) In the final phase, low-arousal casual conversation in Traditional Chinese is heard between the man and a woman. The sound of plastic storage bins sliding and the 'clack' of folding metal chairs being opened fills the audio field. A faint high-pitched whir of a drone is audible at the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Setup Process -> Furniture Arrangement -> Final Result.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to demonstrate the ease and efficiency of setting up a specific model of car-side tent by a single person. It serves as an instructional guide while simultaneously promoting the camping lifestyle and the brands KZM OUTDOOR and ROCK FIELD through high-quality visual and audio production.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Prominent brand logos are visible on the tent fabric and various pieces of camping equipment used throughout the video.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video employs an ASMR-style audio approach, emphasizing the physical sounds of camping gear to create a tactile and satisfying viewing experience for outdoor enthusiasts.
